projects.name: Medico
projects.tagline: One platform connecting patients, doctors, clinics and labs.
projects.description: A full-stack healthcare monorepo. Patients book care and carry their records on a React Native app, while doctors, clinics, labs and hospitals run their workflows from a Next.js dashboard — backed by Express, Prisma and PostgreSQL with role-based access throughout.

fr.tagline: Une plateforme reliant patients, médecins, cliniques et laboratoires.

ar.tagline: منصّة واحدة تربط المرضى والأطباء والعيادات والمخابر.

caseStudy.challenge: Healthcare in many regions is fragmented: patients juggle multiple apps to find doctors, book labs, manage records, and arrange transport. Providers (clinics, labs, doctors) operate in silos with no unified workflow tool. The goal was to build a single platform that connects patients, doctors, clinics, labs, and transport providers — with role-based access, real-time coordination, and a scalable backend.
caseStudy.approach:
Built as a Turborepo monorepo with three apps sharing a common backend:

- Backend — Node.js + Express + TypeScript, PostgreSQL via Prisma, Redis for caching/rate limiting, BullMQ for async jobs (notifications, PDF generation), S3 for file storage
- Mobile — React Native + Expo with role-based navigation (patient, doctor, clinic admin, lab admin, transport provider)
- Web — Next.js 14 admin dashboard for system oversight, verifications, audit logs, and finance

A polymorphic User model drives 7 distinct roles under one authentification system. Over 30 services handle domain logic (appointments, prescriptions, lab requests, payments, messaging, blood donation, emergency).
caseStudy.result:
A fully integrated healthcare platform with:
- End-to-end patient journey: search → book → consult → lab → prescription → records
- Multi-role provider tools for clinics, labs, and doctors
- Admin visibility across all operations (audit logs, analytics, support, finance)
- Production-ready infrastructure: JWT authentification, rate limiting, Prometheus metrics, structured logging

projects.name: OptiVision
projects.tagline: A vision laboratory — WebGL try-on and AI face analysis for eyewear.
projects.description: A dark-luxury optician platform that opens with a scroll-driven cinematic sequence — a WebGL iris, a vision tunnel, an AI face scan — before revealing virtual try-on over live webcam, face-shape analysis with tailored frame matches, an AI stylist quiz, and clinical dashboards for optometrists.

caseStudy.challenge: Buying glasses online is guesswork — people can't tell which frames suit their face, and most optician sites feel like spreadsheets.
caseStudy.approach: I built a vision laboratory: a scroll-driven WebGL intro (iris, vision tunnel, AI face scan), live-webcam virtual try-on, face-shape analysis that matches frames, and an AI stylist quiz — wrapped in dark-luxury motion, with optometrist dashboards behind it.
caseStudy.result: A cinematic prototype that turns frame selection into an experience, pairing real computer-vision try-on with clinical tooling.

projects.name: Mon Magasin
projects.description: A mobile-first platform that helps business owners manage sales, inventory, suppliers, customer debts, and employee activity from a single dashboard. The system includes an AI assistant that provides insights, answers business questions, and helps streamline daily operations, enabling smarter and more efficient business management.

caseStudy.challenge: Small businesses often rely on notebooks, spreadsheets, and multiple apps to manage sales, inventory, suppliers, and customer debts, leading to inefficiencies and poor visibility into daily operations.
caseStudy.approach: Built a mobile-first POS platform that centralizes sales, inventory management, supplier tracking, customer debts, employee access, and AI-powered business insights into a single system.
caseStudy.result: Enabled business owners to manage their entire operation from one app, improving efficiency, inventory control, financial tracking, and decision-making through real-time data and AI assistance.

fr.description: Une plateforme priorisant l'usage mobile qui aide les chefs d'entreprise à gérer les ventes, les stocks, les fournisseurs, les dettes clients et l'activité des employés depuis un tableau de bord unique. Le système comprend un assistant IA qui fournit des analyses, répond aux questions professionnelles et aide à rationaliser les opérations quotidiennes, permettant une gestion d'entreprise plus intelligente et plus efficace.

ar.description: "منصة تركز على الأجهزة المحمولة تساعد أصحاب الأعمال على إدارة المبيعات، والمخزون، والموردين، وديون العملاء، وأنشطة الموظفين من خلال لوحة تحكم واحدة. يشتمل النظام على مساعد للذكاء الاصطناعي يقدم التحليلات، ويجيب على الاستفسارات المهنية، ويساعد في تبسيط العمليات اليومية، مما يتيح إدارة أعمال أكثر ذكاءً وكفاءة."

projects.name: Gestion POS
projects.tagline: A point-of-sale you operate by voice — in Algerian Darija.
projects.description: A retail point-of-sale with desktop and mobile clients and an AI voice assistant that understands Algerian Darija, French and Arabic. Barcode scanning, biometric auth, credit and supplier management, expense tracking and offline SQLite storage with real-time reporting.

fr.tagline: Une caisse que l'on pilote à la voix — en derja algérienne.

ar.tagline: نقطة بيع تُدار بالصوت — بالدارجة الجزائرية.

caseStudy.challenge: Small businesses were struggling with fragmented operations across inventory, supplier management, debt tracking, expenses, and reporting. Manual processes led to errors, delayed supplier orders, and poor visibility into business performance.
caseStudy.approach: Built a full-stack POS ecosystem consisting of a desktop/web POS and a synchronized mobile application. Developed modules for inventory management, supplier orders, supplier settlements, debt tracking, expenses, and real-time reporting. Integrated an AI assistant capable of understanding text and voice commands in Algerian Darija, allowing users to perform actions such as generating and printing supplier orders instantly without navigating through multiple screens. The system was built with a focus on automation, accessibility, and real-time data synchronization.
caseStudy.result: Reduced administrative workload by automating repetitive business operations and document generation. Enabled business owners to manage their entire operation from both desktop and mobile devices while interacting naturally with the system using Darija voice and text commands. Supplier orders that previously required multiple manual steps can now be generated, approved, and printed within seconds through AI-powered interactions.

projects.name: ILMI
projects.tagline: An AI exam-prep arena where students duel to learn.
projects.description: A competition-driven learning platform for Algerian BEM and BAC students. Ranked duels score genuine thinking time rather than connection speed, an AI tutor stays strictly inside the official Ministry curriculum, and an AI coach forecasts exam scores using real coefficients — all wrapped in an Arabic, right-to-left 'Knowledge City' game world.

caseStudy.challenge: Algerian students grind for the BEM and BAC, yet ranked study apps reward fast fingers and internet speed — not real thinking. And generic AI tutors happily answer outside the syllabus.
caseStudy.approach: I designed a competitive 'Knowledge City' where duels score genuine reasoning time, an AI tutor hard-bounded to the official Ministry curriculum, and an AI coach that forecasts exam outcomes from real grading coefficients — Arabic-first and fully right-to-left.
caseStudy.result: A complete product architecture — five distinct AI roles, a curriculum knowledge base, and exam-coefficient modelling — built for the 2026 BEM & BAC cohorts.

projects.name: TagMode
projects.tagline: A fashion storefront for men and women.
projects.description: A fashion e-commerce platform with category browsing, checkout, an admin inventory panel and Chargily payments — dark mode by default, with Firestore-backed products.

caseStudy.challenge: TagMode needed more than just an online store. The goal was to create a premium shopping experience that matched the brand's identity while solving common issues faced by Algerian e-commerce businesses: slow websites, poor mobile experiences, complicated checkout flows, and limited payment options. The platform also needed to be scalable, easy to manage, and capable of handling future growth without sacrificing performance.
caseStudy.approach:
I designed and developed a modern e-commerce platform focused on speed, usability, and conversion.

Built the frontend with Next.js for high performance, SEO, and fast page loading.
Used Framer Motion to create smooth transitions and premium micro-interactions that enhance the shopping experience.
Implemented Firebase for product management, order handling, and scalable backend infrastructure.
Integrated Chargily to enable secure online payments tailored to the Algerian market.
Optimized the entire experience for mobile devices, where most customers browse and shop.
Created a clean product discovery flow with category navigation, search, and streamlined checkout.
caseStudy.result:
The final product is a premium fashion e-commerce platform that combines luxury-brand aesthetics with modern web performance.

Fast and responsive experience across all devices.
Seamless product browsing and checkout process.
Secure online payment integration for Algerian customers.
Easy-to-manage backend for products and orders.
Scalable architecture capable of supporting future business growth.
Strong visual identity that reinforces the brand and improves customer trust.

Tech Stack: Next.js • Framer Motion • Firebase • Chargily

Live Project: www.tagmodedz.com
